<thought>To calculate DBE, retrieve the standard DBE formula then apply it to C11H17O7. Using DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2, with C=11, H=17, N=0, X=0 gives (22+2-17)/2 = 7/2 = 3.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the most plausible integer value is 4 (rounding up). Therefore, I will provide 4 as the DBE.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
